verdict.rationale: v0 is a chat-based builder, and its docs describe safeguards that keep iteration from breaking working code. You can work on isolated branches, preview deployments built from working branches, see CI check status, and publish through pull requests. You can duplicate a branch into a new chat, and the Fix with v0 / Fix Build / Fix CI actions read logs and apply fixes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that follow-up prompts make targeted edits that preserve existing code, any version history or rollback for chat iterations, and independent hands-on reports on regressions during iterative refinement.
